Let me check the live IPython namespace for any already-loaded objects, and inspect the run directory.

```python
import os, sys

# --- Live namespace probe: any DataFrames / variables already present? ---
print("=== Variables currently in namespace ===")
ns = globals()
found_df = False
for name, val in sorted(ns.items()):
    if name.startswith("_"):
        continue
    tname = type(val).__name__
    if tname == "DataFrame":
        found_df = True
        try:
            print(f"  DataFrame '{name}': shape={val.shape}, cols={list(val.columns)[:10]}")
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"  DataFrame '{name}': (err {e})")
    elif tname == "Series":
        print(f"  Series '{name}': len={len(val)}")

if not found_df:
    print("  (no pandas DataFrame objects currently loaded in the namespace)")

# --- Inspect the kuma run directory ---
print("\n=== kuma/run_.../ contents (recursive) ===")
top = "kuma"
for root, dirs, files in os.walk(top):
    print(f"  {root}/")
    for f in sorted(files):
        p = os.path.join(root, f)
        print(f"    {f}  ({os.path.getsize(p)} B)")

# --- Inspect history.sqlite (IPython SQLite history) ---
print("\n=== history.sqlite tables ===")
import sqlite3
hp = "abb-tablegpt-5utytjj_/profile/history.sqlite"
try:
    con = sqlite3.connect(f"file:{hp}?mode=ro", uri=True)
    cur = con.cursor()
    tables = [r[0] for r in cur.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'")]
    print("  tables:", tables)
    for t in tables:
        try:
            n = cur.execute(f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {t}").fetchone()[0]
            print(f"  {t}: {n} rows")
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"  {t}: err {e}")
    con.close()
except Exception as e:
    print("  could not open history.sqlite read-only:", e)
```
